title: fix: resolvido erro ao passar conteúdo extraído do youtube para o agente de buscas
intent: Fixes a bug where the full extracted YouTube content was passed as research context to the search agent. Introduces a dedicated compact formatter (format_research_context) that selects up to 3 segment summaries capped at 400 chars each, stores the result in a new youtube_research_context state field, and removes the old media_contexts lookup at the call sites in both the main and reanalysis graphs.
